AI infrastructure startup Modal says it plans to start using Nvidia's Vera CPUs for the first time for hosting agents, alongside its current Intel and AMD chips. Reuters frames it as Nvidia winning CPU business with another fast-growing AI startup - evidence that Nvidia's Arm-based Vera is becoming a default pairing with its GPUs in agent-hosting infrastructure.
